BackupRun.title: BackupRun

CommandOutcomeView.description:
A command message's outcome, read from the agent's newest `command_completed` or
`command_failed` event for its `wrapper_command_id` (D19); `at` is that event's `ts`.
CommandOutcomeView.title: CommandOutcomeView

CreateTerminal.description: Both sizes are optional; the wrapper validates the 1..1000 range (`invalid_size`).
CreateTerminal.title: CreateTerminal

FileStamp.description: The `mtime` and `size` of a file as the content route (or the last save) reported them.
FileStamp.title: FileStamp

SessionBackup.description:
What a discard would save now; each flag is true only when that save would really run.

`reason` is null when both run, else `no_session_cache` (no `spec.cache`),
`cache_not_configured` (no S3 cache configured) or the save's skip reason, the workdir's first.
SessionBackup.title: SessionBackup

WrapperSettings.description: Typed claude-code-wrapper settings a session may carry (create-time only).
WrapperSettings.title: WrapperSettings

WriteFile.description:
Body of a file save: both keys required; `expected: null` overwrites unconditionally.

A body over 6 MiB + 16 KiB (1 MiB of content, every byte escaped) is 413 `too_large`
before it is read in full.
WriteFile.title: WriteFile

get.description:
The digest of the newest stored tool calls, results and finished turns of the caller's
session, own lines included. `agent` keeps one pod's lines; a name that matches nothing
gives an empty list, since gone agents' lines are history.
get.summary: Recent activity lines of the caller's session, oldest first (read-only)

put.description:
Replace one existing file of the session workdir with `content`; the wrapper answers
409 `file_changed` when the file no longer matches `expected` (null: overwrite).

413.description: The request body is over the limit of a file write

get.description:
One file of the session workdir as raw bytes, streamed from the wrapper (any size).

The wrapper's status is mapped before any byte is sent, so every refusal is a JSON error.
